+    # An unavailable retained-answer file is a transport failure, not a model
+    # abstention. Resume only those failed exact prime requests once their
+    # pinned journals arrive; accepted questions are never retried.
+    if not retained_only and PRIME_QUESTIONS.exists() and PRIME_ANSWERS.exists():
+        with closing(connect(working)) as conn:
+            failed = tuple(
+                (entry, bank)
+                for entry, bank in read(PRIME_QUESTIONS)["coordinates"]
+                if conn.execute(
+                    "SELECT 1 FROM completion_attempts WHERE entry_id=? AND bank=? AND model=? AND code='TRANSPORT_ERROR'",
+                    (entry, bank, model.identity),
+                ).fetchone()
+            )
+        if failed:
+            retry_result = complete_dictionary(
+                working, model, len(failed), entry_bank_questions=failed,
+                continue_cohorts=True, max_calls_per_entry=1,
+                max_entries_per_pass=len(failed), priority="zipf", retry=True,
+                progress=lambda row: print(json.dumps(row), flush=True),
+            )
+            record(WORK / ("typed-prime-recovery-" + digest(retry_result) + ".json"), retry_result)
